title: an outline question opens only on a line the ticket touches
intention: The outline check opens a question on a ticket for an open [Q#n] only when the ticket touches the question's own line or a line beneath it, never for a sibling or parent heading in the same section.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: Q#90 (seals per OS, at 9.4.2.3.3) opened on 0bcb816d6e9c, d58e7887cc99 and 446e42bb2b17, none of which reads or writes a seal, because D8 widens every touch to its first two components and 9.4 is all of CodeMother. Over 295 records D8 opened 139 outline questions; the line rule keeps 40.
traces_to: Law 1 (a question opened where nothing bears on it spends the resolver on nothing) and Law 3 (the rule is the measured one).
how: In outline_check.check, replace the section loop with: an open question at number q is opened when some touched number t equals q or starts with q + '.'; the record's open_questions 'section' field carries the matched touched number. The new proof replays each fixture ticket's recorded touches through a stub reader over a scratch commons with the outline pinned at a63dbc004 (git show). Tooth 4 of the existing proof is rewritten to the line rule. The charter's what and horizon drop the two-component section.

clauses.claim: the recorded reads of 0bcb816d6e9c, d58e7887cc99 and 446e42bb2b17 open no question on Q#90
5243cf9dc630's recorded read, touching 9.4.2.3.3, opens exactly one question on Q#90
a question on a line beneath a touched line opens; one on the touched line's parent heading or a sibling does not

decisions.text: D1: the match is line-or-descendant of a touched number, replacing D8's two-component section.
D2: a new proof, one tooth per clause, fixtures frozen from the recorded reads, outline pinned at a63dbc004.
D3: the existing proof's tooth 4 follows the line rule; its why (a ticket working where a question stands should not reach a build unnoticed) is kept.
D4: the charter's what and horizon name the line rule, written through the artifact door with recompile_gate.sh poked.

measured.saw: Q#90 opened on 0bcb816d6e9c (touched 9.4.8), d58e7887cc99 (touched 9.4.2.3.1, 9.4.2.3.4), 446e42bb2b17 (touched 9.4.2); 5243cf9dc630 and 1b5e86aeec14 touched 9.4.2.3.3
measured.how: read touches and open_questions in CairnCommons/outline_checks/<id>-*.json

measured.how: python over CairnCommons/outline_checks/*.json replaying both predicates on each record's touches
